title: Mohan Lal v. Abdul Rehman
text: The landlord, Mohan Lal, seeks eviction of the tenant, Abdul Rehman, from a commercial property under the Delhi Rent Control Act. The ground of eviction is bona fide requirement of the landlord for his son's business. The tenant disputes the bona fide nature of the requirement and claims to be a protected tenant. The court examines the affidavit of the landlord and his son. The son has acquired professional qualifications and needs premises to start his business. The landlord has no other suitable vacant commercial premises. The bona fide requirement is established. The claim of protected tenant status under the Rent Control Act is negatived as the tenancy was created after the relevant date. Eviction is decreed. The tenant is given four months to vacate. Arrears of rent shall be settled at the prevailing standard rent under the Act.
